role: Minister-Delegate for Autonomy and Disabled Persons (Ministre déléguée chargée de l'Autonomie et des Personnes handicapées)
organization: Government of France (Lecornu government), under the Minister of Health, Families, Autonomy and Disabled Persons
description: Appointed Minister-Delegate on 26 February 2026 following the government reshuffle, reporting to Minister Stéphanie Rist. She succeeded Charlotte Parmentier-Lecocq in the disability portfolio.

role: Member of the National Assembly (Députée), Isère 1st constituency
organization: National Assembly of France (Ensemble pour la République / Renaissance group)
description: Re-elected deputy for Isère's 1st constituency in the January 2025 by-election. Member of the Commission on Social Affairs. Mandate continues; her seat is occupied by substitute Alim Latrèche during her ministerial term.

organization: Sesame endowment fund (fonds de dotation Sesame), Grenoble
description: Founded the Grenoble endowment fund Sesame (launched publicly June 2023), a collective connecting local businesses with solidarity associations to support vulnerable people. Gathered 28 founding companies and 35 associations, with an initial endowment of around 200,000 euros.

role: Member of the National Assembly (Députée), Isère 1st constituency
organization: National Assembly of France (La République En Marche group)
description: Became deputy in March 2020 as Olivier Véran's substitute when he was appointed Minister of Health during the Covid pandemic. Served on the Commission on Social Affairs. Did not stand in the 2022 election; Véran reclaimed the seat.
Practised as a lawyer registered with the Grenoble bar, principally in family law and criminal law, for around twelve years. Withdrawn from the bar roll at her own request (omise du barreau) in 2017.
